name: ENT-03: 04 - High-Value Financial Escalation & Interactive Slack HITL

assignments.name: escalation_reason
assignments.value: ={{ Number($json.total_amount || $json.order_value || 0) > 100 ? 'High-Value Refund Threshold ($' + Number($json.total_amount || $json.order_value || 0).toFixed(2) + ' > $100)' : ($json.sentiment === 'hostile' || $json.sentiment === 'frustrated' ? 'Customer Sentiment Alert (' + $json.sentiment + ')' : 'Executive Manager Review') }}

fieldValues.fieldValue: ={{ "High-value financial escalation dispatched to Slack #ops-approvals (Message TS: " + $json.ts + "). Escalation Reason: " + $("Evaluate Threshold & Calculate Options").item.json.escalation_reason + ". Awaiting executive sign-off." }}

parameters.content:
## Depends on the shared interactions router
The Approve / Offer-credit buttons on the Slack card carry an action_id (lumina_refund_full, lumina_credit_120). The click is handled by the shared interactions router workflow (published in the incident-platform repo), NOT by this workflow. If the router is inactive or its Slack Request URL is wrong, the card posts but the buttons do nothing and the ticket stays escalated_to_human.

Test end to end: send a refund request over $100 to the intake webhook, click a button in Slack, then check the ticket and order rows.
